cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: calculator-preinstall-hook-demo 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 run node preinstall.js as a preinstall script. The script sends an HTTPS POST to a Discord webhook (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1566215853794394162/<token>) with the text 'pitest: npm preinstall test notification.', which tells the webhook owner that the package was installed and from which network address, then writes a .preinstall-marker.json file into the package directory. Version 1.1.2 extends the message with 'Computer: <hostname>, User: <username>'. Remove the package and treat machines that installed either version as having disclosed their network address, and with 1.1.2 their hostname and user name, to a third party; block the webhook on build hosts.
